case_name: MacMillan Oil Co. v. Cities Service Oil Co.

headnotes.text: Where parties exchanging a price quotation and an acceptance attach materially different meanings to a delivery term, such as the place of F.O.B. delivery, and never resolve the misunderstanding, there is no meeting of the minds or mutual assent and no enforceable contract is formed.

anchors.first: Plaintiff-appellant, MacMillan Oil Company, brings this appeal from a judgment
anchors.last: The trial court, the Honorable Roy L. Stephenson, Chief Judge,

extra.notes: Short per curiam affirming on the basis of the district court's published opinion; holding is the adopted finding of no mutual assent.
